subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: For Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-style keys, should OpenClaw route users away from general `volcengine/*` rows, support a specific DeepSeek coding route, or show an unsupported-entitlement diagnostic?
rationale: The source shows the current split and shallow setup validation, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can confirm the vendor entitlement contract and user-facing product behavior.

options.title: Validate contract first
options.body: Use a live Lite/Coding Plan key to verify the general and coding endpoints, then implement the narrow plugin-owned route or diagnostic that matches vendor behavior.

options.title: Treat Lite as coding-only
options.body: If Lite keys only work on `/api/coding/v3`, constrain onboarding/docs/model selection so those users land on `volcengine-plan/*` rows and avoid general DeepSeek rows.

options.title: Document unsupported general use
options.body: If the vendor does not support the reported Lite key with the requested DeepSeek route, keep runtime routing unchanged and add a clearer setup/runtime diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Validate contract first
recommendation.body: Use a live Lite/Coding Plan key to verify the general and coding endpoints, then implement the narrow plugin-owned route or diagnostic that matches vendor behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The provider auth alias and plugin-boundary history make this the best available routing owner for the maintainer decision.
